dimensions.assessment: Directly affects over-the-counter drug manufacturers subject to user fees, the Food and Drug Administration, and pharmaceutical stakeholders.
dimensions.evidence: Each person... shall be assessed a facility fee

dimensions.assessment: Revises fee collection procedures and establishes pathways for real-world evidence and non-animal testing alternatives without fundamentally altering consumer access rights on its own.
dimensions.evidence: utilize standards that allow for the use of real world evidence... to supplement evidence from traditional clinical trials

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes the collection and generation of facility fee revenues and inflation adjustments through fiscal year 2030.

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act regarding user fees, regulatory evaluation standards for topical drugs, and processes for drug switches.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act to revise and extend the user fee program for over-the-counter monograph drugs

dimensions.assessment: Extends program authorities and reporting requirements through the end of fiscal year 2030 and early 2031.
dimensions.evidence: Sections 744L and 744M of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act... shall cease to be effective October 1, 2030.

missing_information: Exact dollar totals for the annual base revenue amounts prior to annual adjustments are not explicitly listed in the text.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill reauthorizes the Over-the-Counter Monograph Drug User Fee Program through FY2030, updates evaluation standards for topical nonprescription drugs, and clarifies application processes for prescription-to-nonprescription drug switches.
